## Collaborations

If you're working on **wildlife disease**, **One Health surveillance**,
**movement ecology**, **spatial epidemiology**, or **conservation
medicine**, and you think there's common ground, please reach out.
I especially enjoy working with field teams and community-based
conservation groups in Southeast Asia.

## Mentoring

If you're a student or early-career researcher looking for guidance on
working at the wildlife–disease interface, I'm happy to chat. I can't
promise to take on every project, but I can usually point you toward
good resources or people.
